_note: Source of truth for Claude Code's /model and /effort pickers. Hand-maintained because CC does not expose available models programmatically (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/12612). Updates: use the `update-lucidos-cc-models` skill — it diffs this file against `claude /model` and bumps entries to match. include_str!() baked at compile time, parsed once via LazyLock — no runtime IO cost. At most ONE entry may claim top capability: Fable 5 is the tier above Opus, so an Opus entry must not be described as 'most capable' — that contradiction shipped once (Opus 5 vs Fable 5) and is easy to reintroduce when a new model is added.
